summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 4Luis crowdfunding platform. Backend APIs mostly functional (15/16 tests passed), frontend UI working well with successful admin authentication and payment modal functionality.

critical_bugs.issue: MongoDB ObjectId serialization error when creating new journeys
critical_bugs.impact: Admin cannot create new journeys through the interface
critical_bugs.error_details: ValueError: [TypeError("'ObjectId' object is not iterable"), TypeError('vars() argument must have __dict__ attribute')]

integration_issues.issue: Journey cards not displaying on homepage despite successful API calls
integration_issues.related_to: Backend journey creation issue - seeded journeys may not be properly serialized

passed_tests: Homepage loads with hero section and navigation
Admin login with 'Admin1' password works correctly
Admin dashboard accessible with statistics display
Journey detail pages accessible via direct URL
Payment modal opens with all amount options (€5-€1000)
All payment methods selectable (Stripe, MBWay, PayPal, Crypto)
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix MongoDB ObjectId serialization issue in journey creation endpoint (/api/admin/journeys POST). This is preventing new journey creation and may be affecting journey display on homepage. The error occurs in FastAPI's jsonable_encoder when trying to serialize MongoDB ObjectId objects.
